snippet.title: Aura Farmers, DEMO out now on #Steam !
snippet.description:
Aura Farmers , DEMO out now on #Steam ! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270900/Into_the_Zone__Arcade_Escape/

Dominate the Goal Zone: Outlast your rivals and seize control to score. It’s not about kills—it’s about relentless control.

Engage in electrifying 1v1 duels, coordinate devastating team assaults, or unleash chaos in massive multi-team brawls! Every round is a wild, skill-testing party you won't want to miss. 

Master the Hammer: Hurl it, teleport to it, and outsmart your opponents with pinpoint precision and cunning tactics.

Blast into the Zone: Team up with friends (couch co-op / local multiplayer) and brawl your way to freedom through the arcade portal. Battle across vibrant, neon-drenched stages where every punch, jump, and power-up bends the rules of reality.

Features Aura Farmers:
* Up to 8 PLAYERS
* Your Squad, Your Rules: Play 1v1, 4v4, 1v7, or any combination you can imagine.
* Couch/Local Multiplayer
* 16 absurd arenas
* Pick from 12 messed-up Outcasts trapped in the Zone. What could possibly go wrong? (Everything.)
* Steam Achievements
* Brutal Mayhem Guaranteed
.. #platformfighter #brawl #brawler #steamgame #indiegame #aura #aurafarmers #gamedev # indiegames #couchcoop #multiplayer #brainrot
